title: Open Work Item (OWI) 0.2
description: One work item from an issue tracker (Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub), in one model, and since 0.2 one change (a pull request) from a code host (GitHub, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps), in another. The document validates a work item; validate a change against #/$defs/Change. The spec is docs/owi/spec.md. Additive changes only; every record declares its version in owi.

OwiId.description: <connection>:<native key>: the toil connection the record came from, then the source's own key (PROJ-123, 42, imagile/toil#9).

Instant.description: An RFC 3339 date-time in UTC, as toISOString writes it.

StatusCategory.description: Where the status sits in any workflow. UNKNOWN when the source gave no category and the status isn't one of the documented defaults.

id.description: The source's own identifier: a Jira Data Center username, a Jira Cloud accountId, an Azure DevOps identity id or unique name, a GitHub login.

name.description: The display name, when the source sent one.

email.description: The email address, when the source sent one.

field.description: The source field the value came from (customfield_10002, Story Points, Microsoft.VSTS.Scheduling.Effort, the Projects field Estimate).

Iteration.description: A sprint (Jira), an iteration path (Azure DevOps), or a Projects iteration or a milestone (GitHub).

path.description: The full iteration path, where the source has one (Azure DevOps).

state.description: Jira's sprint state, as the source reported it when the record was read; past for a closed GitHub milestone.

direction.description: outward: this item <type> the target (this blocks it). inward: the target <type> this item (it blocks this).

name.description: The source's own wording for the link (is blocked by, Successor).

from.description: The status before; null for the first status the history records.

IterationChange.description: The item moving between iterations: into a sprint mid-way (scope added), or from one sprint into the next (carried over).

from.description: The iteration names before, as the source wrote them; empty when there were none.

Reviewer.description: Someone asked to review a change, and where their review stands now.

state.description: DISMISSED: an approval withdrawn or dismissed, or a vote reset.

Change.description: A pull request (OWI 0.2): the change that carries work, from GitHub, Bitbucket Data Center, Bitbucket Cloud, Azure DevOps Server or Azure DevOps Services.

area.description: github, bitbucket, bitbucket-cloud, ado or ado-cloud in 0.2.

key.description: <repo>#<number>, the part of id after the connection.

command.description: The toil command whose output was mapped (github pr get).

url.description: The pull request in the host's web UI.

repo.description: The repository as the host names it: owner/repo, PROJECT/slug, workspace/slug, project/repo.

authorKindSource.description: The signal that set authorKind: an override in the dossier, the account itself, an agent's Co-Authored-By trailer, an agent's branch prefix, or default (HUMAN, no signal).

authorKindSignal.description: The signal in words; null for default.

reviews.description: Every review, oldest first; null when the input held none.

checks.description: The checks on the latest commit, rolled up: FAILING when any fails, else PENDING when any runs, else PASSING; NONE when none ran; null when they weren't read.

checksAt.description: When the checks came to their state: for FAILING, the earliest finish of a check failing now; otherwise the latest check.

mergeable.description: false is a merge conflict; null when the host didn't say.

workItems.description: The OWI ids of the work items its title, branch and description name.

firstReviewAt.description: The first review by someone other than the author.

approvedAt.description: The first approval by someone other than the author.

closedAt.description: When it was merged or declined.

native.description: The source records, untouched, keyed by the command that returned each (github pr list, github pr get).

owi.description: The OWI version the record was written under. 0.2 only adds, so a 0.1 work item is a valid 0.2 one.

area.description: The toil area the record came from: jira, jira-cloud, ado or github in 0.1; an area added later that sends one of their shapes is added here without a version change.

key.description: The native key, the part of id after the connection.

command.description: The toil command whose output was mapped (jira issue search).

url.description: The item in the source's web UI.

typeName.description: The source's own word for the type (Product Backlog Item, Sub-task). Shown beside type.

format.description: markdown (GitHub), wiki (Jira Data Center), adf (Jira Cloud, an object) or html (Azure DevOps). util md converts wiki and adf to Markdown.

resolution.description: How a finished item finished, in the source's words (Done, Won't Do, not_planned, Removed).

history.description: null when no history was mapped for the item, which is not the same as an empty one.

unmapped.description: Every OWI field left empty because the record didn't hold it, and why.

native.description: The source records, untouched, keyed by the command that returned each (jira issue search, github project items).
